info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Deliveries Status API provides real-time insights into the status of deliveries within the food delivery ecosystem. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of various deliveries, enabling streamlined tracking and operational oversight. Typical consumers include food delivery services, restaurant partners, and logistics managers seeking to monitor delivery performance effectively. By leveraging this API, businesses can improve operational efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction through timely updates.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their deliveries. It provides real-time information on delivery progress and expected arrival times.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters for retrieving the status of deliveries. The user can include specific details necessary for the status query.

200.description: Returns the current status of the deliveries.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the deliveries status endpoint.

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the delivery.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the delivery.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit for the operation.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesStatusResponse.description: Schema representing the response for the delivery status operation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information for the delivery operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
